quote: Δ-logics and generalized quantifiers by J. A. Makowsky, Saharon Shelah, and Jonathan Stavi, Annals of Mathematical Logic, Volume 10, Issue 2, Pages 155–192 (1976). This foundational paper studied the Δ-closure of abstract logics and investigated which logical properties are preserved under this operation, including compactness and the interpolation hierarchy.
note: The problem arose from investigations into the Δ-closure of abstract logics and the relationship between interpolation, Δ-interpolation, and the Beth property with compactness. It was formalized and developed further in subsequent papers by Makowsky and Shelah through the 1980s-1990s.
